subject: 黄鹤楼 · 1985年重建主楼正面（黄鹤楼匾一侧）
name: 黄鹤楼
yearNote: 三国吴黄武二年（223）始建，历代屡毁屡建，同治七年（1868）重建之楼毁于1884年；现楼1981年决定重建、1985年6月在距旧址约1公里的蛇山峰岭落成，为钢筋混凝土仿古建筑。年表取1985年，所绘为现楼。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q462372（黄鹤楼）P625 坐标 30.546944, 114.296944，主楼本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 hb_wuhan。
lede: 武昌蛇山上的黄鹤楼，与岳阳楼、滕王阁并称江南三大名楼。三国吴黄武二年（223）为军事瞭望而建，历代屡毁屡建，同治楼毁于1884年。今楼1985年在距旧址约一公里的蛇山峰岭重建：五层攒尖，层层飞檐，每层四面翘角，高51.4米，比古楼高出近二十米。
facts: 始建于三国吴黄武二年（223），《元和郡县图志》载孙权筑夏口城“因矶为楼”；仅明清两代就被毁7次，光绪十年（1884）同治楼焚毁，仅存攒尖铜顶。
1957年建长江大桥引桥时占用旧址；1981年10月武汉市决定重建，1985年6月落成，为钢筋混凝土仿古结构，内设电梯，楼顶四块牌匾2003年重新复制。
新楼共五层，高51.4米，攒尖顶上加5米高葫芦形宝顶，底层各宽30米（古楼各宽15米）；外五内九，每层四面出檐，檐角高翘。
caption: 黄鹤楼 · 主楼正面
近现代 · 1985年重建
structure_checkpoints: 主楼五层，每层四面出檐，各面中央凸出一座歇山山面朝前的抱厦顶，两侧各一个翘角，因此每层正面可见三个翘角；五层檐口自下而上逐层内收，整体呈塔状。
各层檐下为一圈回廊，深红木栏杆（回纹）；每层正面可见约五个开间的廊柱；顶层正面悬横匾（留白），顶为四角攒尖，顶上葫芦宝顶。
底层外围另有一圈宽大的单檐抱厦与廊庑，黄琉璃瓦，正面正中亦悬匾（留白）；底层立在带白石栏杆的台基上，两侧有石阶。
画面去除：台前铜鹤雕塑、灌木、游人、红灯笼、路灯与两侧坡道栏杆；保留台基轮廓与正面台阶。
material_observations: 屋面黄色琉璃瓦，檐口翘角处带绿色琉璃剪边；木构、栏杆与柱均为深赭红色；檐下斗栱与彩画青绿；台基与栏杆白色石材；宝顶金黄。
author: 螺钉

additional_sources.author: Nature42
additional_sources.role: 另一侧（“楚天极目”匾面）近景，核对各层檐口、翘角与底层抱厦

source_note: 主图为螺钉 2017年8月自楼前广场仰视，五层檐口、攒尖宝顶与底层抱厦、台基完整；补充图为 Nature42 2016年另一面近景（CC0）。线稿去除铜鹤、灌木、人群、灯笼与路灯。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Yellow Crane Tower (1985 rebuilding) in Wuhan, seen straight-on from the front plaza (Image 2; Image 3 shows the opposite face for eave detail only). Draw a FIVE-storey tower of pagoda-like silhouette: five tiers of glazed-tile eaves stepping inward as they rise, each tier with a small gabled projection at the centre of the face and an upturned corner on each side (three upturned corners visible per face per tier). Each storey has a surrounding balcony with a fretwork railing and a row of slender columns behind it. The top storey carries a blank horizontal plaque and a four-sided pyramidal roof crowned by a gourd finial. Around the ground floor a much wider single-eave porch and side galleries, also with a blank central plaque. The whole stands on a stone terrace with a balustrade and a central flight of steps. Omit the bronze crane sculpture, shrubs, lanterns, lamp posts, people and the side ramps.
Orientation: portrait 1024×1536.
